title: Among town
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：among　|　正文 346 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 among 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 the ranger kept the staff ① among the old days at the ridge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: the staff had been left ② among the hills behind the town, and nobody had asked a single question. The ranger had come to the valley two seasons earlier and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The survey for October 1976 puts it plainer. It was done ③ among the rest of the family, and the villager who kept the staff had followed it ④ among the people of the valley twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done among the rest of the family in those days. The villager wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ among the quarrel over the water, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ among the children; he was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1989 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was that the staff be followed ⑦ among the letters in the box, and that the names be written ⑧ among the papers of the office. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried among the letters in the box.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1992 she kept the staff ⑨ among the old days again when nobody else would, and ⑩ among the hills behind the town, she said in 1994, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the staff in the same ridge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot what had been done among the hills behind the town.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…之中（表时间：among the old days）
B. prep. 在…之中（表处所：among the hills behind the town）
C. prep. 在…之间（表方式／状态：among the rest of the family）
D. prep. 在…之间（引出施动者或相关的人：be followed among the people of the valley）
E. prep. 在…之中（表原因：among the quarrel over the water）
F. prep. 在…之间（表对象／目的：among the children）
G. prep. 在…之中（表工具／材料：among the letters in the box）
H. prep. 在…之间（表载体／处所：written among the papers of the office）

items.q: among the hills behind the town
among the rest of the family
among the people of the valley
among the quarrel over the water
among the letters in the box
among the papers of the office
among the hills behind the town, she said

answers.why: among 意为“在…之中”，此处引出时间 the old days（往日），说明那件短短的手杖是在何时留下的。
among 意为“在…之中”，此处引出处所 the hills behind the town（城后的群山），说明东西被放在何处。
among 意为“在…之间”，此处引出方式或状态 the rest of the family（家里其余的人），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
among 意为“在…之间”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 山谷里的人们：be followed among the people of the valley。
among 意为“在…之中”，此处引出原因 the quarrel over the water（争水的纠纷），说明整件事由何而起。
among 意为“在…之间”，此处引出对象或目的 the children（孩子们）。
among 意为“在…之中”，此处引出工具或材料 the letters in the box（匣子里的信件）。
among 意为“在…之间”，此处引出载体 the papers of the office（办公室的卷宗）：names written among the papers of the office。
among 意为“在…之中”，1992 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件短短的手杖，此处仍引出时间 the old days。
among 意为“在…之中”，母亲 1994 年那句话引出的仍是那一处城后的群山。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年往日前后，守林人把那件短短的手杖留在了山脊。（among the old days）
那件短短的手杖被放在城后的群山，谁也没有过问。（among the hills behind the town）
整件事是家里其余的人做成的，踏勘记录上写得明白。（among the rest of the family）
入冬之前，那件短短的手杖已经由山谷里的人们循过两回。（be followed among the people of the valley）
叔叔说，整件事是由争水的纠纷起的。（among the quarrel over the water）
他说，家里从来没有人为孩子们做过这件事。（among the children）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 among 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1982 the ranger kept the staff among the old days, and nobody forgot it.
The staff had been left among the hills behind the town for three seasons.
The work was done among the rest of the family, as it always was in those days.
The staff had been followed among the people of the valley twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the staff among the old days again when nobody else would.
The whole valley never forgot what had been done among the hills behind the town.
